instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React and Tailwind CSS exclusively in .js files (NOT .tsx).
Enforce pure black background globally (`bg-black`). Do not use gray or tinted darks for the main canvas.
Use Bodoni Moda for headings and Outfit for body text. Apply them directly via standard Tailwind utility classes after configuring tailwind.config.js.
CRITICAL: Apply `data-testid` attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.
The Hero section must be asymmetric. Text on the left. In the Hero, the word 'Link' in 'Dot Link' should use the gold accent color #F5C518.
For the Worlds section, utilize a Bento Grid. Display the 5 worlds using their authentic colors as faint glowing accents inside black cards.
The store badges should be custom designs indicating 'Bientôt disponible' and featuring the Apple and Google Play icons (use lucide-react).
Integrate the background images provided in the media section, using opacity and mix-blend modes (e.g., `opacity-20`, `mix-blend-screen`) behind the hero text to create the cosmic dusty atmosphere.
Ensure all legal pages are built and routed appropriately with standard template content, ensuring compliance with Apple/Google/Stripe requirements.
